description: Get compact details for one Danish parliamentary afstemning/vote cast, related legislation and verdict IDs with reference_lookup tool instructions, and paginated party vote breakdown. Use get_vote_cast_votes for the full roll-call list of individual politician votes.

party_vote_limit.description: Maximum number of party vote breakdown rows to return. Use 0 to omit party vote items while keeping counts.

party_vote_offset.description: Offset into the party vote breakdown list.

vote_cast_id.description: Vote cast / afstemning ID from search_vote_casts or vote search results.

name: get_vote_cast
